reviews.review_description: They arrived prepared. Sub-box was already built. Installer came the day before to make sure everything would fit.

We had our solar installed last week. Hielscher were helpful, friendly, factual, knowledgeable, efficient, organised, punctual from David in sales, the installers and the admin team.  We could not have asked for better.Liz and Jeff Trinity Beach
From the quote to installation, everything was easy. Didn't have to worry about claims or paperwork. Installation was quick and neat, guys put in extra effort to make the inverter space work for us.

From start (quoting) to finish (installation) I couldn’t fault Hielscher Electrical. The installers very polite, punctual and did a great job cleaning up & removal of my old system.Customer service contacted Ergon & advised of the upgrade install.The installers help set up the app on my phone & did a thorough walk through.

From getting a quote through to installation the team from Hielscher Electrical have been excellent. They have been friendly, courteous and knowledgeable with all things solar related I highly recommend them.
Efficient and reliable. Very informative staff.Recommend them for sure

Sales/quoting & installation was very well done. Everyone I dealt with was knowledgeable, polite & efficient.My installer was very patient & showed me how to use the web page & app. I couldn’t have asked for better service.

David was great providing us with 2 quotes and breaking each one down for us in terms of consumption, value for money etc.Installation was on time and quick. The team left our place super clean and tidy after installation and were really easy to deal with on  the day!The app to track consumption and usage is really easy to use and was explained really well by Brock before he left.

Hielscher were easy to deal with from quote to install.Their office team kept in contact through a drawn out quote process (we were moving into the property during this time) and worked with us to find solutions to a few challenges we had.Brenton knew his equipment well and created a layout that gave us a great sized system on our best roof face. He even made time to come and map the system out on the roof with the bracket installer during his Christmas holiday shutdown period.Install happened smoothly and efficiently on the day they booked it. The only tiny issue we had with one panel clip appearing not to have been tightened down correctly was fixed with no fuss as soon as they could come back again.

After phoning from a friend’s recommendation from Carolyn in the office to David for the quote and later Peter and his installation team were very professional and most efficient.I have already recommended another friend and I hope your business continues to grow as you deserve the praise
Easy to deal with. Everyone was pleasant professional and cleaned up after themselves.

The team were very prompt through the EOI and quote process and came straight out for a measure and quote. They were really attentive with multiple phone calls to check timings and make sure everything was lined up for installation. Installation day was a breeze, the boys were efficient and very approachable. I'll definitely be recommending Hielscher to anyone after quality solar.
Great professional service and installation led by Brock along with his team. Very happy !

Quote was super quick and easy. Options to consider and great recommendations.The crew turned up on time, explained the install process and then got straight into it. Job was done quickly and before i knew it, they were cleaning up and i was being given a run down on how everything works. Every step of the way was great service. I am super happy with the product, install, price. Definitely made the right choice.

Brock and the team from Hielscher electrical were amazing from the start to finish with our solar installation.  On initial consult with brock he was very knowledgeable and easy to talk to and made it easy to understand the workings of the system . Instal was done so quickly and professionally and any questions we have had after have been answered promptly.
From the day of my quote to the finish of installation Hielscher has done an excellent job and they made the whole process so easy thank you to the whole team

From Brenton who organised a quote, to Carolynne who kept us updated re installation dates etc to Troy and his team who did the installation, everyone was fantastic. I cannot fault this group and will be contacting them again when we need batteries! Seamless communication, very very tidy installation and left the place as they found it.You won’t go wrong by engaging Brenton and the Hielscher team.
Customer service 100% satisfied.  Very helpful. David offers great service. The installation was fast and efficient and we had great communication throughout the whole process
From the quotation process to after care I could not be happier.  The customer service and care was exceptional and the installation was exactly on time and to the letter.

From quote to finish of install the Hielscher team , Brenton ,admin staff and trades were all A1. I am very happy with job and info we received, I would recommend their services to anyone looking to solar or any elec services they offer.

I was very happy with the group of men Brocks groupthey were efficient tidy and capable.I was shown how to read inverter.my house is not on wifi so I could not have app on phone which is a shame.  I expected to after telling brenton I wasn’t on wifi.I have roaming internet which allows me full internet coverage all the time.Ergon will do hook up soon i’ve  had a couple emails but nothing definite.  Be nice when its all connected. I presume Ergon will tellme.thankyou

This company was great from start to finish. David the sales expert was prompt, efficient and knowledgeable. The installation team led by ‘Rob’ were great. They worked well together, were friendly, pleasant, organised, tidy and knowledgeable. The product is great and Rob helped me load the app to my phone and explained the relevant information to me in a way I could understand. The communications I had with the office team was also positive. Thank you to everyone at Hielscher Electrical and Solar!! We are very happy!

The process from the beginning till the end was fantastic. Firstly, the quoting process was very professional and easy to understand, David explained everything, and he came out to the house to measure it all out. He went through my current electricity bills to make sure the solar panels we were getting would be the best fit for our family.The installation was very easy and quick. Explained and showed us how to use the charger. The customer service overall was amazing.
From the initial phone enquiry to the completion of the install, I could not fault a single thing. Thankyou to the whole team for their guidance and expertise to make the process so easy.
The options were exactly what I required.

Brilliant from the beginning to the end of installation kept me informed was referred to Hielscher electrical by a fellow tradesman as this company is Cairns based has been for quite a long time not like the fly by nighters trying to make a quick buck then gone this is an established local company can't recommend them more thanks again for a pleasant solar experience.thank you Hielscher electrical.

Highly recommend the team at Hielscher Electrical! Excellent service from initial contact to full installation. We couldn’t be more satisfied with the tidy solar panel install and competitive pricing.
From start to finish they were great to deal with. very professional team.
Dave was amazing, very knowledgeable and continued his assistance post installation. The install team were incredible- nothing was a problem for them and they went above and beyond to assist us
Super efficient process from quote to install.  Everything was organised from onsite to liasing with energy provider making the process easy.   Highly recommend
Fantastic service! The whole process was smooth and easy from getting a quote and a quick site inspection to the day of the installation. I can highly recommend Hielscher. Thank you so much!
Very good communication from both office staff and installer. Happy to fit in with our changing schedule.Sales and quoting a very smooth process.

If you’re thinking about Solar or Batteries and can’t make up your mind which Company or who to use, Well let me point you in the right direction.Brenton at Hielscher Electrical should be your first choice, the quality of workmanship and knowledge his team deliverers is exceptional, being a tradesman myself I’am extremely particular and have high expectations on quality of workmanship, which his team didn’t disappoint in anyway or form.I’am not normally one for doing reviews but if you’re fussy like me and want quality of work with backup sales & service, look no further then this fantastic Company, I have Solar/Battery System and are about to increase the size of my Batteries ? even larger, & I wouldn’t trust anyone else to do it.Even happy to talk to anyone regarding my experience with Hielscher Electrical, you won’t be disappointed with your choice 10/10

Brock and his team did a great job, they were very professional carrying out their work and helpful with any questions we had. Brock took the time to show us the relevant app and Web site for monitoring our new solar system.The staff leading up to the install were also very helpful and friendly. It looks like the owner Brenton has a great crew.

Sales/Quoting process was excellent.  My install also required an upgrade of my electricity board and relocation of the Point of Attachment.Received the quote - experienced some delays regarding financing and Hielscher were very understanding and patient nd followed up regularly with me.Due to the added complexity of my install, waited 5 months from date of paying deposit before install took place. However, now that it's done - I'm very pleased.They were punctual, polite, tidy and the customer service was excellent.

From initial phone call with Caroline to Brock and the boys installing, upmost customer service.The job was done fast efficient and left cleaner than it was before.Everything explained in detail and after seeing the power flow in, I feel comfortable the guys came up with the best system size for my needs.Local company that cares about what they do and the quality shows.Thanks guys!
An easy and painless experience from initial contact to completion of installation. Approachable and prepared to answer all questoins we had. Would not hesitate to recommend their services.
From start to finish, amazing team to deal with !Office ladies and techs just friendly and professional through our whole process
Hielscher Electrical were fantastic from start to finish.  A big thank you to Brock and his team for a professional install and would highly recommend to anyone.

Hielscher Electrical were referred to us by a friend who was super impressed with their service - communication, punctuality, technical advice and so on. We had been considering for a while to install a system in our home, but with so much hype and sad stories about solar installations, we had done nothing about it. Steve's enthusiasm kicked us into action and we took no time to contact Hielscher. We had a representative visiting us the same day and it was all smooth from there untill installation. We reiterate the feedback that we got from Steve unreservedly.
Everything was really professional. Would recommend Hielscher to anyone else.

We couldn’t be happier! Hielscher were fantastic to deal with from start to finish. They responded to communication promptly, they were happy to spend as much time as we needed answering our questions and explaining the process to us, very professional, efficient and respectful while on-site installing the system, and organised the grid connection immediately. The whole process was seamless.The team is incredibly knowledgeable and I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone!
The whole process was conducted on time and to a high degree of professionalism

Couldn’t ask for better service. Quote easy to understand. Clearly outlined my options and what it would cost. Installation went well. Tradies very quick, neat good quality work. Just stress and hassle free.Could not expect better service than what I got.

I went with Hielscher Electrical as I felt happy with the choice of Panels and Inverter, they were about middle with their quote, neither the cheapest or the dearest.David from Hielscher was the only installer that got on the roof to check it out. The installation went well, they were prompt and tidy.After solar had been installed, David rang a few days later to check that I was happy with the service and whether I had any questions. When I did he came out personally to check it out.Due to all the damage caused from Cyclone Jasper, I still haven’t had my system connected to the grid, but due to circumstances this is to be expected.

From the first call back from Caroline I could see that customer service was important to Hielscher Electrical.  David (the sales consultant) was excellent from the outset, with top notch advice and the patience to explain all options and their pros & cons.  He prepared numerous quotes with different options and enough useful info to help make the decision easy.  The installation date was brought forward and the crew turned up on time.  Very fast and efficient with everything done right and all mess cleaned up.  Troy, the electrician, was amazing.  Superb work quality and explained everything very well.  The system works great and performs to the expected level of production.  Couldn't be happier with Hielscher Electrical.

After considering for awhile to update our solar panels we were given a recommendation to Hielscher Electrical.We had someone come around and go through the whole process. He was very informative and was happy to answer all the questions.After receiving the quote we decided to go ahead and put the deposit down.They were always letting us know the updates of when they will be installing the panels.On the day of the job they were very punctual and everything went smoothly. It was an extremely hot day and they worked through it all.The job was done in one day and we are very happy with the product so far.We had four guys here and they were all very approachable and professional.We would highly recommend Hielscher Electrical it’s great to be able to support local businesses.
Could not of been easier fantastic tidy polite on time and ver easy to talk to about the install.

Quote, deposit very easy. Plan for installation date clear and Met. Invoice included government Subsidy which was a welcome surpriseInstallers attended and installed solar cells on roof and inside control boxAll went smoothlySome miscommunication about NBN. Would be great to get instructions at time of installationThanks for supporting the move to increase renewable energy

Found the sales process to be upfront to the point. Sold me the size I nedded and did not try to add bells and whistles. Did not rubbish other providers as this was one of the things that annoyed me from other providers.Once contract was signed I did not have to do anything else.Installation was 2 weeks early than quoted.The instalation team were very professional and the on site electrician did a great job of explaining the system.

I'd have no problem recommending Hielscher Electrical for your solar installation. Their consultant David was very helpful and gave a very thorough explanation of my options.                                                                                                                 Installation team were great, turned up on time and had the job completed in three and a half hours and did an excellent job. No fuss, no mess, happy customer.

Hielscher Electrical were thorough from the quoting process through to Installation. Kept us informed of dates for Installation. Team Leader Brock was efficient and Professional, kept us informed of how the process was going and after it was completed showed us how it worked and how we can monitor usage. Very Professional outfit and we would recommend them highly.

Recently had Hielscher Electrical team install our solar panels & battery system and we could not be happier. From the initial quote to install the team have been so friendly & professional. The pricing was very fair & we look forward to all but eliminating future Ergon energy bills! Caroline has been our main point of call & we are extremely happy with her kindness on every contact we have had. The install team were efficient & respectful & explained everything so well! Thanks Hielscher electrical!

This was an angst free experience from start to finish.Hielscher managed the whole process effortlessly,  and were meticulous providing information and answering queries. The installation took about 5 hours, including clean up and familiarisation process. Good work all round.

Excellent service all round.The communication from the start was great. A quote on a Saturday morning, options provided on different sized systems and quotes were provided within days.Once the quote was selected, communication about install times was quick and clear.The system was installed earlier than first advised, due to an opening.On the day, the crew turned up on time, and were done within a few hours.Brock went through the app and back over the key need to knows of the system.Site was left clean and tidy.There was follow up from Hielscher about the experience and checking I was happy.Great company, will definitely be recommending to others.

Quick and accomodating when I first called for a quote.Gave me plenty of time for questions. No pressure.Booking in a day to suit my need for installation was considered.At installation, team were on time, polite, tidy and efficient. When installation completed a member of Hielscher helped me set up my phone app and explain it to me.A follow up call was made a week later to check everything was okay.Proffessional from start to finish.

I had a system that was not working correctly and decided to renew. After doing lots of research and getting quotes, I found Hielscher Electrical to be the most reliable, knowledgeable, and honest from the word go. They do not push cheap non warrantable systems in the hot wet tropics onto unsuspecting consumers. From sales to the site visit to the install was everything a consumer could want. No BS in the sales approach to ascertain if I really need to upgrade or just try and repair.Absolute invaluable on-site visit that explained my options fully, with no pressure whatsoever to proceed. Having a difficult 2 storey install in a shade and location affected area, the system recommended overcame the difficulties and is performing magnificently.The installers: very well led by a true professional who modified the system install to ensure that the electronics are well weather protected (Cairns), in a lengthy 2 story install on curved roofs. The install team were all professions who got quickly about their specific parts of the install. Most obvious was the teamwork and how they all looked out for each other in trying hot and working at heigh risky conditions.From my perspective, the fact that Hielscher Electrical are local (Cairns) are, well respected in the trade, and component manufacturer backed and trained for the system I chose was mandatory for ongoing warranty and at call trouble shooting if needed.
Polite, punctual, excellent sales service, knowledgeable, organised for the grid connection
Very happy with the service and installation. Came out and discussed options and installed as agreed. Competitive price and local Cairns business.

Prompt response to my request for a quotationconsultant was punctual, knowledgeable & informative - answered all my questions - made recommendations based on my current consumption plus accommodations for potential future upgrades for which he took the additional time to prepare alternative quotesWas incidentally the only consultant out of 3 who actually physically got on the roof to measure upAll communication with the office was friendly concise & accommodatingInstallation team were also punctual - after brief introductions confirmed the preferred location of the inverter & proceeded with the installation which they expedited in a very professional mannerUpon completion they went over the system operation with me - downloaded & demonstrated the Fronius app & completed all the required paperwork for the power provider on my behalfVery pleased & impressedGraham

The company were very professional from the quoting stage right through to the installation and administration. All relevant permits were lodged making the transition smooth and easy as us, as the customer.
Friendly staff and super efficientFollow up calls have been wonderful
Seamless from enquiry to installation.  Solid advise, professional service, great communication, excellent timeline and faultless installation.  Excellent team to deal with.
From my first phone call right through to installation cannot be faulted.

Beginning with first contact to the office and subsequent calls, really impressed with how the whole process was undertaken. Sales quote process was very professional and informative, with no pressure to make any decisions.The guys were friendly and approachable, no questions were left unanswered. Totally cleaned up when job was completed. The guys arrived when they were booked to arrive. We had a short discussion and they got straight into the job.Customer service was exceptional, we were completely shown how to access all information regarding the system and ran through how the system operates and what we could expect from the system going forward.

An excellent team with great communication, swift installation and follow up service. 26 quality Solar panels up and running by lunchtime !! Hielscher made the whole process easy because they're true professionals and a pleasure to deal with.

The entire process was seamless. The timelines were exceeded and the install process was undertaken in a very professional manner.Any mess, which was minimal was cleaned up and taken away.A follow up was undertaken to ensure we were happy with the install and if we required any further information

Through out the whole process from quoting to organising the grid connection, the whole team where polite, punctual and always kept communication lines open.  The installers where very informative, professional and produced a high quality system and installation.

A very professional team installed the Solar system, took them 5 hours to complete the 6.6KW system and i was producing my own electricity. Great supporting staff sales/quoting together with a very competitive price.

Hielscher attended promptly to quote. The consultant provided more detailed information than I had received from others. After notification of their successful quote they attended promptly and completed the installation as agreed in a timely and competent fashion. They arranged the grid connection with our grid provider. The whole job was completed and site cleaned up in just over half a day.

From the get-go all stages of the installation have been professionally completed, good communication to ensure the customer is always kept in the loop, the office customer service is friendly, informative and quality.

Quote on site was thorough and measured to fit max solar panels, as our roof has tiles and many angles. The customer service from Carolyn was excellence. Everything all explained from start to finish, arranging roof tiler to arrive before solar panels can be installed and much more. Hielscher guys were very polite and tidy and done an excellence job. We have been added to the grid and now waiting for ergon to install new meter.I would highly recommend Hielscher Electrical, especially with tile roofs as most companies avoid these or overcharge on roof tiler fees.BEST PRICE AND BEST QUAILTY AND SERVICE.Thanks guys, for a stress-free installment!
The team at Hielscher Electrical were absolutely awesome from day one until finish. The whole team were all so helpful.

Only 2 of Solar Quotes 3 recommended providers contacted me and provided quotes. Of these, very few reviews were from my regional area (Cairns). So I looked further into Solar Quotes’ approved installers and found Hielscher Electrical with lots of excellent reviews and requested a quote from them. Had a visit from their representative that afternoon to discuss my requirements and to view the site.The quote from Hielscher was competitive price-wise to the earlier 2 quotes, but for the same price the components offered were superior.  So the final decision was an easy one. Although the estimated installation lead time was 10 to 12 weeks it was only 6 weeks until the actual installation date.Installation was surprisingly fast and all was completed in under 3 hours.  The installation team was fantastic and all went without a hitch.  The final result looks fantastic and everything so neat and tidy.  The clean-up was so good you would not know they had been there apart from the panels on the roof, the inverter in the garage and the revamped meter box.  The system included the Fronius power monitor and it’s fascinating to view the panel output and power consumption in real-time and   to see historical data as well to plan when appliances are best used.I could not be happier with the final product and can happily recommend everyone from Hielscher for their fantastic service.

The team at Hielscher Electrical are extremely professional from the office staff during follow up to the installers and the after sales service. Every step was explained clearly with no surprises or hidden costs. The team installing the solar included me in the decision making which added the personal touch.Their pricing was very competitive, communication was clear and every outcome was achieved. I can’t praise them enough of how easy my experience was, I really appreciate the time they took to explain and answer any query I had.I would recommend them to anyone in FNQ looking to have solar installed.
Heilscher Electrical completed all the work as they said it would be done and it was.They completed your three questions as good as.every part of their service was A1.

Great customer service right from the first phone call all the way to the end. David took the time to come & see us on a Fri afternoon to do a quote personally.Price was good, not the cheapest out of all quotes but service & quality of product was part of our decision.Installation team was punctual, friendly & informative. They guys were happy to answer all my questions & explained how it all worked.Very happy with our decision, now we hope to see the value of our purchase in our future power bills.

I was given Brentons name from a friend who recommended him, and I am very happy that I did. Professional from start to finish. From the girls in the office to the boys doing the install. They were fast, and efficient.  My house was left clean and tidy when they finished. I would 100% recommend Brenton and his team (who are a local business as well).

I chose Hielscher, solar Cairns mainly from two others  that had installed solar with Hielscher, all comments were above average overall and commended their experience.From the quote to the installation I couldn't fault this company, price was right, solar products seemed to be of better quality than others and installation was great. I was told all about the  start to finish procedure and the crew were great. Im happy with my 6.6 solar, highly recommend.

Everything went as promised. Both installations were completed in one day. Ours has performed as expected. The only glitch we experienced was caused by the Ergon technician who forgot to turn the inverter back on. This was fixed by a call to Heilscher's office but we had also lost power to our pool. Although it was not their problem Heilscher arranged for two of their electricians to divert from their normal routine and come to Port Douglas and fix our electrical problem. This is much appreciated.We would recommend Heilscher Electricians without reservation

From start to finish the team were punctual, professional and gave a good range of options with full explanation and details. When they completed the install the place was left clean and tidy. Can't fault them, and they offered better quality for a better price.

Hielscher Electrical - Solar Energy have so many positive reviews, which really do speak for themselves.We did so much of our own research and to have friends and numerous family members back it up, we were looking forward to speaking with Hielscher Electrical - Solar Energy, from initial consultation they didn't disappoint!Their customer service and communication has been absolutely exceptional, from the ladies in the office to the gentlemen at installation. I could not fault the process from start to finish, even receiving a follow up phone call after installation really highlighted how incredible this company is.As a young family / stay at home Mum and continuously paying those high electricity bills something needed to give, it's been about a month after installation and we already know huge changes will be seen at our upcoming electricity bills, Hubby and I look at our Solar App often and it does not disappoint seeing those dots going back to the Ergon Grid. Crazy to say, but we're actually looking forward to our next Ergon Bill. HahaIf your family is considering Solar, I without a doubt recommend speaking to Hielscher Electrical, they're a reputable and local company who deserve far more recognition than I alone can give.I cannot thank Brenton, Carolynne and the rest of the team enough, as it's truly been pleasant dealing with Hielscher Electrical - Solar EnergyBest thing we've done for our family.CheersThe Hurst Family
1) Great price and quality of product2) On time, organised and clean3) Great customer service everything with Ergon taken care of
The service from the beginning was exemplary, right through to installation, the lads installing were polite, considerate and professional. Absolutely recommend to anyone considering hoing solar

The whole quoting process, Brenton quoting to the installation. All staff were extremely polite and professional. Installation went smooth and fully explain prior to leaving. Really enjoying the app that you can track and learn from your power usage. Even more impressed that app works from "Hot Spot" don't even need to have home fixed internet, GREAT.When I leave the premises obviously the Hot Spot internet connection disconnects, but upon returning home and connecting hot spot, all data is updated on the app.

We contacted Hielscher Electrical with regards to having solar installed. David, the salesman, arranged to meet at our residence to discuss options and provided us with options. We decided to go with a SolarEdge/StorEdge system with a battery as we wanted the backup power in case of a power loss.  David was unsure of where the exact inverter location may be and arranged for the owner Brenden to meet onsite to ensure we understood and were able to further clarify the location and what the procedure for installation was to be. Siting the battery was the challenge as we had limited wall space. We discussed the need of a second battery but were advised to wait and see how this system met our needs as it should do the job well and we then wouldn't over capitalise unnecessarily.We were given the ability to choose a date to suit and the install was done.Troy and the boys arrived right on time and were very professional and meticulous with the install, very easy going and willing to answer questions as they were able. Except for the appearance of an inverter and battery on the wall and panels on the roof you wouldn't know they had been.We also have the monitoring ability through the app which is very comforting to see how the system is performing.At this stage, if the monitoring system is correct, we would expect to be able to recoup our expenses by around the 10 year mark which is within the warranty of both inverter and panels.

Right from the get go from the sales to installation these guys are seasoned professionals. Meeting the sales guy was positive, informative and easy to follow. Any information I asked for was presented to me to help me make my decision on purchasing a solar system freely and professionally. The installation was amazing, these guys were well organised, on time and respectful not only to me but to one another and nothing was a problem. I was also in the situation of needing a new hot water system and explained I needed to find a plumber to install it, Carol was amazing, told me she would call me back for she had a plumber in mind. She rang me back to tell me the plumber would be at my home at 9.00am, the same day of the installation of the solar was happening. They took the worry of sorting issues out away from me and took care of it all for me. This company ticked all the boxes and I would and am recommending them to anyone who is considering purchasing and installing a solar system. Thanks guys.

Dave that came to my unit to talk to me about solar was fantastic & because of him I went through your company. Troy & Dylan & all the boys  were fantastic. Troy put up a new power metre in my kitchen for me & was very clean & Dylan put up the Fronius intervert up & was very clean & tidy. Troy rang Ergon as there is high voltage & have organised for Ergon to fix the problem.The boys did not mind my dog Moe watching them.I could not have asked for a better crew they were fantastic & all very polite & knew what they were all doing. A special thank you to Troy & Dylan

David initially contacted me to arrange a convenient time to come out and give me a quote. He was informative and polite, answered all my questions and helped with all aspects of the install.When I asked to upgrade the panels, he was more than willing to accomodate the change and give a competitive quote.The install process was painless, it was all done in 2 afternoons (the panels hadn’t arrived yet on the first afternoon).The install guys were polite, helpful, took all their rubbish with them and did an excellent job on the install. Afterwards they ran me through the shutdown procedure, Inverter app setup for remote monitoring and any questions I had.Easy from start to finish, I highly recommend Hielscher Electrical.

Brenton was very informative and helpful in relaying what the system was about and how it all worked.The office staff (Carolyn) were very polite and helpful as well.Early days after the install but going by the systems performance so far, it's looking very positive for the future.

We are very impressed with Hielscher Electrical from the initial discussion and quote to the completion of the solar system. We were kept informed of the progress and at installation the team were very professional and each new their particular duty and that was handled with pride. The fitting on the roof is excellent and every thing is aligned. After completion all rubbish was collected and taken with them. Well done boy. Will recommend to friends

Dave gave us a quote for a 7.8 system and when the installers turned up and got on roof there was an obvious discrepancy of whether it would fit. I had solar put on my last residence and the system was all planned and outlayed on his lap top in front of me. Also at this stage ( 3 weeks ) we are still waiting for Ergon. The installation went great otherwise and Carol was very efficient

Dave came to our house and he was very knowledgeable. He talked to us in way we could understand and it made sense for both of us.The installation went great with no problems. The whole team worked together well, they were all happy, well mannered, punctual and worked under pretty horrible conditions, but never lost the smile! They were absolutely fantastic!Carolyn and all the girls on the phone were really friendly, follow up was great.We have thought about solar for a while and we can only say Thank you to all the team for making it all so easy and smooth.We will definitely recommend you to anybody we know that is interested in solar.

Hielscher helped our community Kindy to install a complete new system after we experienced a few not so great solar installation companies. We were kept informed about the whole process from beginning to end. This was reassuring for us.

Sales/quoting was straight-forward, with many options available.The installation went very well, such a professional and efficient crew!Customer service is/was excellent. They turned up with the Ergon electrician to do the grid connection.Brilliant work ethic, very polite, very professional.We could not be happier.
